newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ryan invests 5.4 mln punts in Gresham hotel.
newsitem.headline: Ryan invests 5.4 mln punts in Gresham hotel.

text.p: Ryan Hotels Plc announced on Monday that it planned to increase the size of the Dublin-based Gresham Hotel by 50 percent.
Ryan said in a statement that it will invest 5.45 million punts to construct a 100-bedrooms extension together with a multi-storey car park with 160 spaces.
Ryan, who signed a contract with R&B Construction to complete the project, said the hotel will employ a total of 230 workers after the new wing is added.
The hotel chain said it was completing a one million punt upgrade of its Killarney Ryan Hotel and had just completed a 2.4 million restructuring of its Galway Ryan hotel.
